_note: pepin.head_server (the board, systemd pepin-head): the head ESP32's serial port, the head IMU's configuration and the server's own clocks. The face itself is config/face.json.

serial.note: the CH340's udev name (board/99-pepin-usb.rules); 921600 until 2000000 is measured clean (the 'S' line's rx_errors and the server's crc_errors stay 0) at both ends

imu.note: the head MPU6050: output rate (1000/n Hz), DLPF_CFG 3 (44 Hz, 4.8 ms delay: the mast sways at ~5 Hz), +-4 g, +-500 deg/s (the neck pans at up to ~290 deg/s, past +-250). Sent to the ESP32 as 'C' at every (re)connection

clock.note: the clock map's lower envelope: the smallest (receive time - ESP micros) per bucket_s of ESP time, a line fitted through the last window_s of them (offset and skew), less half the smallest ping round trip
